responsibility: Implements the CR16 backend’s C-side target logic that complements cr16.md and cr16.h. This file defines the TARGET hooks and helper routines for CR16 ABI and code generation decisions, including option override and conditional register usage, argument passing and structure return handling, frame-size computation plus prologue/epilogue expansion, frame-pointer elimination, PIC/address legalization, constant legitimacy, unwind mode selection, operand/address printing, attribute handling, and assembler emission helpers for multiword operations. In effect it owns the executable backend policy for stack layout, saved-register handling, calling convention details, target attributes such as interrupt behavior, and various utility emitters that consume GCC RTL/tree state and produce CR16-specific RTL or final assembly sequences.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C/C++ implementation file for the CR16 port: it defines target hooks and helper routines such as option override, argument passing, frame/prologue/epilogue logic, PIC address legalization, attribute handling, operand printing, and assembly emitters that the machine description calls. Unlike cr16.h it does not declare the port mostly through preprocessor macros, unlike cr16.md it does not encode RTL instruction patterns/templates, and unlike cr16.opt it does not declare command-line target options.
